sentences.text:
The applicant has preferred this petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. challenging the order dated 25.07.2023 passed by the XVII Additional Sessions Judge, Indore in S.T. Case No.417/2023,
whereby application submitted by the applicant under section 451 and 457 of the Cr.P.C. has been allowed subject to furnishing Fixed Deposit of Rs.2,00,000/- for taking the interim custody of the vehicle Chevrolet Cruz bearing registration No.MP-04-CG-3705.
2.

Brief facts of the case are that police station Sanyogitaganj has seized the vehicle Chevrolet Cruz bearing registration No.MP-04-CG-3705 in crime No.179/2023 registered for commission of offence punishable under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is registered owner of Chevrolet Cruz bearing registration No.MP-04-CG-3705.
He is a poor man and he is not having any Bank Guaranty of Rs.2 lacs.
He further submitted that the seized vehicle is not having any value of Rs.2,00,000/- .
He has also submitted that imposing such type of condition is like to deny to give in the interim custody of the vehicle.
The applicant is ready to furnish surety in place of Bank guarantee.
Therefore, he prayed for modification of the aforesaid condition.
4. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposes the submission made by the learned counsel for the applicant and prays for dismissal of the petition.
5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6. From perusal of the impugned order, it appears that the condition imposed by the Trial Court is too harsh.
The Court should not impose such condition, which would make the delivery of the vehicle almost impossible.
Under these circumstances, the present petition is partly allowed.

7. It is directed that, if the applicant submits a surety bond for a sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lacs. only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court, the aforesaid Chevrolet Cruz bearing registration No.MP-04-CG-3705 be released to him on supurdagi.
The remaining conditions of the supurdagi imposed by the Sessions Court are being intact.
Certified copy, as per rules.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Pankaj Evane Through Aammukhtriyar ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72669929/
